test_title: PYST 227: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13th Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, NEWSPAPER is written as ODXTQZQDS and SORT is written as TNSU. How will CHOCOLATE be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08c777a36f898d492c29ef3a13c1a9aad5b988568e613e5a9282d9466dd8871.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**1) Vowels are coded as -1**

**2) consonants are coded as +1**

NEWSPAPER is written as ODXTQZQDS.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c205aaf404df7036cf8dc6c236d4e64d7e94719fd77ca9e08718cf3f235ff348.png] 

SORT is written as TNSU.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77732e13a3c3ed47ca981ca10e15af9dd8c053b59851b8a4e163a173e531f42c.png] 

Similarly,

**CHOCOLATE = ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46e052ac7620ea1d75fe3bb0590af393356b811adb3bf31d08d09f2f44c79a91.png] 

Hence, '**DINDNMZUD**' is the correct answer.
